title: helianthemum vineale
intro: Helianthemum vineale, commonly known as Rockrose or Frostweed, is a perennial plant in the Cistaceae family, native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum vineale include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating respiratory tract infections, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
